description: Try Plus before paying: submit up to 20 BLINDED tokens (base64, from plus-sdk blindTokens()) and receive blind signatures — identical BLINDED passes to paid ones (the server never sees a pass; unlinkable to the claim only once the Plus mint key is pinned in the witness-chained head, K3, and only to the IP if the claim rides Tor — claims use the direct lane).
